human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Replace broad run-wide evidence attachment where possible with the minimum sufficient triggering evidence for each governance signal, while preserving deterministic signal identity and existing rule semantics.
human_pressure.why_now: A governance system must prove why a judgment exists; attaching the entire run to each signal weakens audit precision and explainability.
do_not_misread: Do not drop necessary evidence merely to reduce counts.
Do not change signal predicates or severities.
Do not add probabilistic confidence scoring.

machine_core.goal: Make signal evidence_refs minimally sufficient and directly attributable to the rule trigger wherever current projection data supports it.
red_lines: Do not remove evidence needed to reproduce a signal.
Do not change signal rule meaning or severity.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path.
invariants: Every signal remains reproducible from its cited evidence and canonical projection state.
Record-backed signals cite their record evidence refs.
Run-level signals may remain broad only when no narrower canonical evidence attribution exists.
Signal IDs remain deterministic for equivalent evidence.

producer.artifact: canonical projections and scoped governance records

observable_effect.assertion: Signals cite the smallest supported evidence set without changing whether the signal is emitted.

proofs.assertion: Signal tests verify emission parity, evidence-ref precision, determinism, and no missing proof references.

failure_semantics: If a rule lacks sufficiently precise source attribution in current models, preserve the broader evidence set and document the limitation rather than guessing.
Missing direct evidence never produces an invented pointer.

steps.title: Audit signal evidence sources
details: Identify rules currently attaching projection.evidence_refs where a narrower triggering set already exists.

steps.title: Tighten direct attribution
details: Use record or triggering-event evidence refs without changing predicates or severity.

steps.title: Preserve broad refs when necessary
details: Do not guess a narrower source when the canonical model cannot prove it.

steps.title: Prove parity and determinism
details: Assert the same signals emit before/after while evidence refs become more precise only where supported.

acceptance: Broad evidence is retained where precision is not supportable.
validate: python -m pytest tests/test_governance_signals.py tests/test_authority_governance.py tests/test_approval_governance.py tests/test_budget_governance.py -q

must_check: Evidence refs remain sufficient to reproduce each signal.
Rule predicates and severities are unchanged.
No provenance is inferred from producer-specific payloads.
reject_if: Signals disappear because evidence was over-pruned.
Evidence refs are invented or inferred without source support.
A provenance graph or confidence scoring system is introduced.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Signal and governance-record suites directly prove evidence-ref attribution while full suite protects reports and replay.
